role_title: NEPA specialist / NEPA coordinator / interdisciplinary team leader
description: Shifts from authoring EAs/EISs under one CEQ rulebook to running agency-specific procedures (some now handbooks), choosing the level of review, managing statutory page and time limits, documenting CEs, supervising applicant-prepared documents, and keeping a defensible record. Fewer EISs and more CE determinations are likely where CEs expanded (USDA plan-level CE; Reclamation CE consolidation).

role_title: Junior environmental document writer / NEPA analyst (consulting and agency)
description: First drafts of resource sections, literature and legal comparisons, and comment binning were how juniors learned review. These are the tasks AI now handles (DraftNEPABench: 1-5 hours saved per subsection; CommentNEPA in production) and the tasks v1 called S. Without a designed substitute (supervised validation work, mock hearings, record audits), the pipeline to senior NEPA judgment thins.

Moves from reading and coding comments to validating AI groupings, finding unique substantive comments, and drafting legally adequate responses. Very large dockets (371,657 comments on the 2026 Roadless proposal; more than 220,000 on WOTUS) make AI triage unavoidable. If SPEED passes, unique comments would decide who can sue.

role_title: State permit writer (NPDES, Title V, CWA 404 assumed programs)
description: Must manage the oversight relationship and the federal predicates of delegated authority, adapt to unsettled WOTUS jurisdiction, and produce structured permit data for digital systems. The Florida 404 reversion (2026) shows that program authority, and so the workforce built on it, can vanish when federal predicate actions fail.

role_title: Good Neighbor / partnership agreement program manager
description: 540 Forest Service GNAs in FY2025 (426 with 39 states). Counties and Tribes can now retain revenue, recreation GNAs began January 2026, Colorado extended state GNA authority to DOI agencies in 2026, and 20-year agreements are proposed. State forestry agencies and counties need staff who design agreements, administer timber sales and manage retained revenue.

role_title: County natural resources / public lands coordinator (cooperating-agency liaison)
description: Counties can hold GNAs and retain revenue. Under DOI procedures they must justify cooperating-agency participation, which bureaus can deny with reasons. SPEED would create 'local cooperating agency' status. County staff become intergovernmental negotiators, not only commenters.

role_title: Tribal natural resources / environmental program director
description: New revenue-retaining GNA authority, uncertain federal support for co-stewardship (EO 14112 rescinded 2025-03-14), and consultation duties that persist while NEPA accelerates. Tribal directors act as sovereign regulators, rights-holders and agreement partners at once. TN must validate this description.

role_title: Permitting technology product owner / permitting data steward
description: Created by the 2025 Presidential Memorandum, the CEQ Action Plan (agency adoption within 90 days) and data standard v1.2. Bridges statute and procedure with BPMN/DMN screening logic, structured documents and dashboards. The ePermit Act would make it statutory. It is SC-primary because the product is a lawful process, with heavy DC.

role_title: Corporate climate disclosure / regulatory affairs manager
description: Federal disclosure is receding (SEC rescission proposed 2026-05-29; GHGRP cuts proposed), while California SB 253 reporting starts 2026-11-10 and the EU CSRD continues with narrower scope. The role splits into multi-jurisdiction compliance strategy (statecraft) and emissions accounting and assurance (data craft).

role_title: ESA consultation biologist (Services and action agencies) / HCP negotiator
description: The harm rescission (effective 2026-09-12), the end of the blanket 4(d) rule, the 4(b)(2) exclusions rule and pending section 7 changes alter what is negotiated in incidental take statements, HCPs and 4(d) rules. Litigation was noticed on 2026-07-15, so practice must hold up under either outcome.

Jurisdictional determinations remain unsettled (2025 proposal, 2026 supplemental proposal, no final rule), so specialists must also know state and Tribal wetland law for waters outside federal jurisdiction.

With the federal GHG endangerment finding rescinded, air districts are litigating (Bay Area AQMD v. EPA, filed 2026-04-16) and leaning on state authority. District staff need litigation-support, rulemaking and coalition statecraft that v1 does not cover (6.7.5 sits under EH&J).

role_title: Applicant-side environmental review / permitting manager (energy, infrastructure, mining sponsors)
description: New tools: paying for Sec. 112 acceleration, preparing EAs and EISs for agency evaluation, adopting CEs, and dealing with ESA and Section 106 as the new critical path. The role grows in scope and moves closer to the agency's own work.

role_title: Entry-level policy analyst (agency, NGO, think tank)
description: v1 classifies policy literature review (6.4.1 T1) and legal comparison (6.1.1 T2) as substitution. The analyst ladder loses its first rung unless entry work is redesigned around validating, synthesizing for a specific decision, and briefing.

Seven County's deference and limits on vacatur reduce litigation leverage. SPEED would add a 150-day limitations period and a unique-comment standing rule. Advocacy shifts toward early engagement, durable comment craft, state and local venues, and statutes outside NEPA (ESA notice letters).

role_title: Third-party neutral / environmental mediator and facilitator
description: Agency demand for required public process falls (no public involvement required for CEs and EAs under DOI), but contested decisions and partnership agreements need neutral convening for legitimacy. The net direction is unknown. The status of the federal environmental conflict resolution program (Udall Foundation) was not verified this session.

USDA's 2026 procedures can categorically exclude plan amendments and revisions, and the 2026 objection rule shortens windows. Planner statecraft moves from EIS management to component drafting, objection resolution and monitoring commitments (consistent with OpenLMP's 58,544 plan components as demand signal).
